property_summary: Invariant: calling Collect never changes MinSum in the correct contract (MinSum remains what was set before), but the mutant inverted the initializer check allowing MinSum to be updated only when initialized, so under certain call sequences Collect can lead to a different MinSum observable after the call in the mutant.
change_summary: Invert the condition so it only sets MinSum when intitalized is true (previously it set only when not initialized), changing when MinSum can be updated.
